consequence.statement: The deprecated setting continues to work but is scheduled for removal in v1; environments still using it must move to ProxySecretRef.
consequence.remediation: Identify which field/key the notice is attached to by diffing the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install.yaml, and migrate it to ProxySecretRef before v1.

original.statement: A line added to install.yaml in flux2 v2.7.0 states that an unidentified setting is deprecated in favour of ProxySecretRef and will be removed in v1.

decision.reason: The computed diff between [ev-782bc47d120d] (v2.6.4) and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] (v2.7.0) adds the line "Deprecated: Use ProxySecretRef instead. Will be removed in v1." It marks something as deprecated now, with removal planned for later, and names its replacement. That matches the deprecation kind: it still works today and is scheduled to break in a later version, so the class is review. The text doesn't say which field is deprecated, but that only limits subject and applicability; it doesn't change what this consequence is. Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts show only "apiVersion: v1", so the reading rests on the diffed line itself.
